definitions.relative_error: sum absolute error / sum observed flow; not MAPE
definitions.sample_sd: Sample standard deviation over seeds 0, 1 and 2; descriptive, not a confidence interval
definitions.communication: Analytical float32 weight payload only; not measured wire or JSON transfer bytes
definitions.iid: Random sensor membership, not proof samples are statistically independent
definitions.inference: Seed 0 centralised and non-IID FedAvg checkpoints fixed before export; no best-seed selection
